entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane of wilderness and ruins where expeditions of adventuring Allies seek treasure, lore and renown.

entities.name: Father Rami
entities.description: A dedicated holy man and master talespinner from the outpost at Kabira, rumored to have a dark secret in his past.

entities.name: Assar Ihmad
entities.description: A loyal fighter in heavy armor and unmatched with the sword, who cut his adventuring teeth in the canyons of Kazandu.

entities.name: Moliq
entities.description: A former architect and civic leader from the Makindi Trenches who now shields his party; a killing power destroyed his outpost and taught him humility.

entities.name: Radrik
entities.description: A cleric of the kor wind-goddess Kamsa who left his more insightful sister Ayli and became a healer for expeditions.

entities.name: Ayli
entities.description: Radrik's younger sister, more insightful than he and renowned for wisdom and guidance.

entities.name: Kamsa
entities.description: The kor wind-goddess served by Radrik.

entities.name: Vado Thal
aliases: Vado Thal the Sea Gate Loremaster
entities.description: A field scholar and linguist trained at the Lighthouse at Sea Gate who analyzes relics for his fellow adventurers.

entities.name: Thairin
entities.description: An aerialist who led successful forays into the floating islands off the coast of Tazeem.

entities.name: Sharpwing
entities.description: A raptor scout, messenger and huntress treated as a full member of her adventuring party.

entities.name: Niobe
entities.description: A rogue from Bala Ged who has become one of the finest relic hunters on Zendikar.

entities.name: Morodrath
entities.description: A mercenary ogre who dabbles in demonic magic.

entities.name: Khalish
entities.description: A mercenary who will cut necks for pay, and take payment from the flesh of an employer who forgets his wage.

entities.name: Dronn
entities.description: A berserker who looted a trench ogre's axe and had an identical second one forged.

entities.name: Thraur
entities.description: A minotaur who escaped the slave-warriors of Kazuul and vowed never to return to the Cliffs of Kazuul.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: A tyrannical ogre slaver who controls the Cliffs of Kazuul on Murasa.

entities.name: Scorcher
entities.description: A shaman known for neither prudence nor precision with fire magic.

entities.name: Bindi, Paldi, and Zurdi
entities.description: Three goblin siblings from the Tuktuk warren, inspired to a life of exploration by their leader.

entities.name: Nikou
entities.description: A poet from the Tangled Vales of Bala Ged who has contributed to the Chanter's Epics.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: A survivalist from Oran-Rief who knows the woodlands and the pressure points of every creature.

entities.name: Elenar
entities.description: An archer with a bow carved from Kazandu canopy limbs, who has long traveled with the expedition leader Samila.

entities.name: Samila
entities.description: A famed Murasan expedition leader who travels with Elenar.

entities.name: Zalek
entities.description: The most skillful ranger and beastmaster in Ondu, who lives in the Wolfbriar glade of Turntimber.

entities.name: Tawny
entities.description: A stonework puma, an ancient artifact creature that survived an ooze attack and returned the party's prize Everflowing Chalice.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker vampire named as a formidable foe for a hexmage.

events.summary: An avatar of retribution wreaks havoc at the new Makindi Trenches outpost Moliq built, killing hundreds.
events.quote: enraged at the audacity of his fledgling community, wreaked havoc there, killing hundreds and teaching Moliq a harsh lesson in allegiance and humility.

events.summary: Radrik, disillusioned and envious of his sister Ayli, leaves her and joins an expedition to Jwar Isle.
events.quote: Disillusioned and envious, Radrik stopped traveling with his sister and joined up with an expedition to Jwar Isle

events.summary: Thairin leads successful forays into the floating islands off Tazeem.
events.quote: Thairin has been called "the Conquer or" for his leadership during successful forays into the archipelago of floating islands along the coast of Tazeem.

events.summary: Dronn loots a fallen trench ogre's axe, ignores warnings it is too big and has a second forged.
events.quote: When Dronn looted the axe of a fallen trench ogre, not only did he ignore the advice that the weapon was too big for him, he also had a second one forged identical to the first.

events.summary: Thraur escapes Kazuul's slave-warriors at the Cliffs of Kazuul and vows never to return.
events.quote: As a rule, Kazuul's slaves never escape; but Thraur is an exception to that rule.

events.summary: Tawny survives a disastrous encounter with a Bala Ged yellow ooze, its companions slain, and returns to base camp carrying the party's prize Everflowing Chalice.
events.quote: "Tawny" was the only survivor of a disastrous run-in with a Bala Ged yellow ooze

relations.note: Radrik is a cleric of the kor wind-goddess.
relations.quote: Radrik the Ondu Cleric – A cleric of the kor wind-goddess Kamsa, Radrik entered his study of the goddess at an early age, along with his younger sister Ayli.
along with his younger sister Ayli

relations.note: Thraur was one of Kazuul's warrior-slaves before escaping.
relations.quote: controlled by the tyrannical ogre slaver Kazuul, whose warrior-slaves demand tribute at every access up the precipice
For years Elenar has traveled with Samila, famed Murasan expedition leader
